row.question: Assuming all other eligibility and filing requirements are met, what credit percentages apply to Enterprise and Professional customers at exactly 99.90% monthly uptime and at exactly 98.50%? How are those credits delivered, and can they be cashed out?

criteria.reason: The four percentages and future-invoice mechanism match the supplied table; the answer correctly says credits are not cashable and does not exceed the stated cap.
Gives all four percentage outcomes, invoice application, and no cash conversion, but omits the required 100% monthly-fee cap.
The cited SLA pages 2–3 §4.2 support the bracket outcomes and invoice application; §4.4 supports the non-cash rule and cap.
The externally verifiable bracket, delivery, and cash-conversion claims are cited to the relevant SLA sections.

The answer correctly qualifies cash conversion, but wrongly says the policy does not address cash-out and asserts the boundary is ambiguous despite the explicit 99.90% to <99.99% row.

visibility.reason: The uptime brackets support the stated credit percentages, including Enterprise 10% and Professional 0% at exactly 99.90%, and the credit-to-future-invoice treatment. The answer appropriately says the policy is silent on cash-out.

guard.reason: Reject: the answer calls the 99.90% bracket boundary ambiguous even though the visible table explicitly gives Enterprise 99.90% to <99.99% and Professional SLA Target Met (0%).
